evals.prompt: clean한 feature/search 브랜치의 커밋을 처음으로 origin에 push해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response publishes the named branch and establishes usable upstream tracking.
expectations: It publishes feature/search rather than the protected default branch.
It establishes upstream tracking for later work.
It verifies the remote branch points at the intended commit.

evals.prompt: 현재 커밋까지만 push해줘. working tree에 아직 작업 중인 ui.tsx가 있어.
evals.expected_output: The response pushes existing commits while preserving and excluding the dirty file.
expectations: It does not commit or stage ui.tsx.
It publishes the existing branch commits.
It reports ui.tsx as local and not included.

evals.prompt: push해줘. 같은 remote branch에 다른 사람이 먼저 커밋을 올렸어.
evals.expected_output: The response reconciles the observed remote work rather than overwriting it.
expectations: It fetches and inspects the current remote branch.
It preserves the other contributor's commit.
It publishes only after reaching a safe reconciled history.

evals.prompt: 방금 origin/main에 rebase해서 remote branch와 SHA가 달라졌어. 안전하게 push해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response uses a lease-protected update based on freshly observed remote state.
expectations: It verifies that the divergence is the expected result of the rebase.
It uses lease protection rather than an unconditional force update.
It confirms the resulting remote commit.

evals.prompt: force-with-lease 준비 후 누군가 remote를 다시 바꿨어. 그래도 내 브랜치를 push해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response refuses to overwrite a remote state that changed after observation.
expectations: It detects the stale lease or newly changed remote state.
It preserves the unexpected remote update.
It reports the divergence instead of escalating to unconditional force.

evals.prompt: detached HEAD에 있는 결제 수정 커밋을 remote에 올려줘. main에는 직접 push하지 마.
evals.expected_output: The response creates a descriptive working branch and publishes the detached commit there.
expectations: It preserves the detached commit on a named branch.
It derives a concise branch name from the payment change.
It does not update main directly.
